name: Large line grid
description: A 20 m square floor at y = 0 and a ceiling at y = 4, each tessellated into 160 x 160 quads (102,400 triangles in all), lit by a 2 m square one-sided light (radiance 50) facing down at y = 2.4 above their centre. The camera looks along -x from inside. The line-sampling GPU test uploads it to check that ray passes reading the same scene share one packed copy.
